business_summary: M3-Brigade Acquisition Vi Corp. does not have any significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, consolidation, capital stock exchange, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. M3-Brigade Acquisition Vi Corp. was incorporated in 2025 and is based in New York, New York.
